title: Allen Nunis
description: "I feel, next to Boba Fett's outfit, Leia's hunter costume (from RETURN OF THE JEDI) is one of the best of the series," says Allen Nunis. A protegé of Al Williamson, Nunis has spent five years providing artwork for the role-playing game industry, including the STAR WARS RPG from West End Games. Recent projects include cover work on the Classic STAR WARS reprint, an ALIENS mini-series (both for Dark Horse) and JASON GOES TO HELL (inks) for Topps Comics.
